outcome: academic school performance (reading, writing, spelling, grammar and punctuation, numeracy)
cohort: Children born at 28+ weeks of gestation in New South Wales, Australia, who had grade 3 education outcomes linked via the National Assessment Program-Literacy and Numeracy (NAPLAN) between 2009 and 2014.
finding: While crude models showed an increased risk of poorer school performance in children exposed to preeclampsia, these differences were largely attenuated and mediated by perinatal and childhood factors, especially gestational age at birth.
